input.disclosure: TYPED_RELATION_DISCLOSURE_CANDIDATE_V1 (prospective, audit-only), verified as an exact refinement of the delivered coarse relations
input.observed: in-service bit and positions from the observable view

mayAlter: dependency rewiring in the conditional ledger
conditional continuation branch semantics (which BYPASS branches exist)

rules.rootSubstitute: Root BYPASS at t0: lexically lowest typed substitute of the failed target whose source is observed in service (= available && health>0, the kernel substituteFor predicate). Exact.
rules.continuationSubstitute: Continuation BYPASS: if exactly one typed substitutes edge enters the failed target, the substitute is that source conditional on the branch being legal; otherwise UNKNOWN. Future liveness is never asserted.
rules.rewiring: Every BYPASS removes the (dependent -> failed) dependsOn edges from the ledger graph (exact: the kernel removes them); when the substitute is known the (dependent -> substitute) edge is added.
rules.branches: A continuation BYPASS exists only for a ledger dependsOn edge into a target with at least one typed substitutes edge. Relations change only by BYPASS rewiring, so absence is exact current structure.
rules.unknown: Every continuation branch keeps UNKNOWN legality/survival/terminal status; guaranteedFutureBranches=0.
